div.div:
فِيهِ مُنْتَفَدٌ عَنْ غَيْرِهِ In him is that which renders thee in no need of any other. (Aboo-Sa'eed, T, L, K. *) ―
-b2- إِنَّ فِى مَالِهِ لَمُنْتَفَدٌ Verily in his wealth is ample provision. (AZ, T, L, K *) ―
-b3- تَجَدُ فِى البِلَادِ مُنْتَفَدًا (in the TK مُتَنَفَّدًا) Thou wilt find in the countries, or towns, a place to which to flee and in which to seek gain; syn. مُرَاغَمًا وَمُضْطَرَبًا (K.) See also مُنْتَفَذٌ.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
